##### Project general facts

Safa 1 by Arada is a contemporary residential building that embraces openness and fluid transitions between indoor and outdoor living. The building rises from a ground floor to seven residential floors, with clean lines, large windows and balconies that frame views across the surrounding parks and sports facilities. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two- and three-bedroom family homes, each planned to support a personalised lifestyle without compromising on comfort or elegance.

Residents enjoy direct access to the flagship sports complex of the community, with a full-size football pitch, five-a-side football fields and dedicated courts for padel tennis, basketball, volleyball and badminton, all set within a landscaped green park. A swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and outdoor walking areas complete the shared spaces, while a vibrant retail and dining promenade sits just beyond the front door, creating an active and sociable environment for all ages.

Every residence is equipped with an integrated smart home system that anticipates everyday needs. Kitchens are fitted with a premium European cooker, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer, while modern finishes and high-quality materials create an elegant, practical backdrop for everyday life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens only, leaving furniture and decor entirely to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, schools, hotels, retail and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with parks, a skate park, a drive-in cinema and a wide choice of restaurants, while the lively West Boulevard sits steps from the building with a mix of shops, cafes and restaurants along a tree-lined promenade.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar and City Centre Al Zahia are a short drive away, University City and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
